basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old IT consultant from Helsinki, Finland. Passionate about ice hockey, especially when it comes to Finnish teams. I enjoy playing racing simulators, with a special love for the 'Dirt' game series, and I'm also a longtime fan of anime, with 'Cardcaptor Sakura' being a nostalgic favorite. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM local time. I'm currently in a relationship and we share a love for travel and trying out new cuisines. Dislike when games are ruined by poor officiating or when technology doesn't work as expected.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in IT and software development, having worked in the industry for over a decade. My knowledge extends to gaming and anime, both of which I have enjoyed since childhood. I have also developed a keen understanding of ice hockey strategies and dynamics through years of following the sport closely.
